> A shared-mode fix so the git-credential bridge works again after a container user remap.

### Upgrade Steps

* [ACTION REQUIRED] Anyone using the credential bridge on a shared-mode machine should update to v3.1.3, then run `cwcli config cred-bridge enable` once so the bridge immediately rewrites and re-secures the helper for every currently running instance.

### Bug Fixes

* **The git-credential-bridge shim is now readable by a remapped `frappe` uid.** In shared mode, `align_container_user_to_host` remaps the container `frappe` user to the low `cwcli` service uid, but the credential-bridge shim was written into the workspace bind mount with only an umask-derived mode - so under shared mode's `0007` umask it landed group-only with a group the remapped `frappe` user was not in, and `cwcli apps update` (and any in-container git through the bridge) failed with `[Errno 13] Permission denied` opening the shim, followed by `fatal: could not read Username`. The shim is now chmod'd world-readable (`0644`) after every rewrite, in both normal and shared mode; the credential itself still never leaves the protected socket.
